title: Fixed Radial Coat Tree and Umbrella Ring
description: One original complete fixed central coat tree with an integrated lower umbrella-ring appearance. A tapered central post rises from three whole curved feet on finite flat pads; six continuous curled radial branches at two levels form the hanging crown. A shallow thick annular drip-tray appearance and a separate open three-spoke umbrella ring attach to the same post and shared base. All numeric geometry newly authored, not the old planar twin-upright peg rack plus independent stave bin imported or resized. Three opaque constant PBR materials, no clothes, umbrellas, liquids or textures. One whole prop, zero scenes. Fixed visual furniture only: no clothing/umbrella compatibility, actual drainage, load, hanging performance, stability, manufacture or safety claim.
